content.title: Decode Base64 to Billede
content.p1: Found a long string of tilfældig tegn starting with data:image/... and don't know what it is? It's likely a Base64-encoded image.
content.p2: Vores Base64 to Billede Decoder converts that text string back into a visible image file (PNG, JPG, GIF, etc.) that you can view and download to your computer.

features.title: Key Features
features.f1_desc: See the image immediately. We parse the binary data and render it on your screen.
features.f2_desc: We automatically detect the file format (PNG, JPEG, GIF) from the header of the Base64 string.
features.f3_desc: Save the decoded result as a real image file to your hard drive with one click.

how_to.title: Hvordan Decode?
how_to.step1_desc: Paste your Base64 string into the textarea.
how_to.step2_desc: We instantly attempt to read the string.
how_to.step3_desc: If valid, the image appears on the left.

use_cases.title: Almindelig Brug Cases
list: Debugging: Tjeking what image data is being sent in API responses or stored in databases.

Bekræftelse: Sikring af, at en Base64-streng ikke er beskadiget.
